packageRules.description: typescript-eslint does not support TypeScript 7 yet (plugin load fails); lift when it does.
The packageManager pin is toolchain, so non-major updates merge themselves.
The toolchain pins (mise, nvm) move with packageManager, so they merge themselves too.
Repo-internal tooling merges itself through the queue; majors stay manual.
The published surface (dependencies/peerDependencies) is a release decision, not a bot's.
